Scoring Zones (Front & Rear Body)
formation1: Scoring Zones: Head, Arm, Hand, Leg, Foot, Sole, Same/Opposite
notes: Head: Above jaw-line. Arm: Shoulders to armpit, including hand. Hand: Wrist to finger tips. Leg: Hip joint to crotch, including foot. Foot: On or below anklebone. Sole: Plantar aspect. 'same': Left-left or right-right. 'opposite': Left-right or right-left.

name: Sub-Group Turn Direction Symbols
formation1: Single Arrow: Turn in indicated direction. Double Arrow: Turn in either direction.
notes: Single arrow indicates direction of turn by a sub-group. Double arrow indicates turn in either direction.

name: Clarification of Intent & Foot Grips
formation1: Square, Inverted Triangle, Circle: Intent clarification. Circles around grips: Foot grips.
notes: Geometric shapes indicate clarification of intent. Circles around grips denote foot grips.

name: MFS Camera Perspective & Dart Legend
formation1: A: Edge-on (on level), B: Above (trailing/above), C: Below (leading/below).
notes: A: Edge-on view (camera flyer on level). B: View from above (camera flyer trailing/above). C: View from below (camera flyer leading/below). Note: Depicted for reference only, not a performance requirement.

name: Feet-to-Knees
notes: foot dock on opposite upper leg

name: Totem
notes: feet dock on top of same shoulders between neck and arm

name: Legend for INTER Moves (Turn, Carve, Flip, Loop)
formation1: Turn: vertical axis. Carve: turn + translation. Flip: pitch transition. Loop: flip + translation.
notes: Turn: rotation around vertical axis (location unchanged). Carve: turn combined with horizontal translation. Flip: pitch transition around lateral axis. Loop: flip combined with horizontal translation.

name: Camera Perspective & Dart Legend
formation1: Edge-on view, view from above, view from below.
notes: Dart orient parallel to relative wind. Edge-on: level with subjects. Above: trailing looking into wind. Below: leading below subjects.
